transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, Under Neon has its press screening coming up Friday evening at the Calder Cinema. I have final authority on the public-screening protocol, and I want to make sure we're all aligned before we move forward. The current draft includes the full interview segment plus a conventional open-floor Q&A. Before we distribute any press materials, the screening packet needs to go through its routine sign-off against the clearance memo and event brief. I'd like to hear from each of you on where things stand so we can make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

transcript.text: I need to flag something important. This morning I reviewed a signed amendment regarding the interview subject's clearance. The amendment specifies that the interview subject permits public screening only with their face blurred and their name omitted. I have confirmed the amendment is valid, but I have not yet added it to the master clearance memo. This directly affects the current draft, which includes the full interview segment without those restrictions, and it needs to be reconciled before we proceed with any sign-off or distribution of press materials.
